## About this Style

High rise. Slim fit. Straight leg. We took your favorite high rise and updated them with an ultra-modern straight leg with a tailored design. Part of our signature ‘Lot 700’ fits, our Tailored 724 Straight jeans are designed to flatter—all day, every day.

- A versatile fit with a flattering high rise
- Finished with an ultra-modern tailored straight leg
- Designed to flatter—all day, every day
- Authentic denim character enhanced with supersoft stretch. For jeans that'll leave you starry-eyed. That's Levi's® Stellar Stretch. Thanks to excellent built-in recovery, they champion your curves and move with you—without sagging or bagging—everywhere and every wear.
